content.text: Loading Skip to Main Content ×search HomeResidentsBoston Marathon April 20, 2026 Boston Marathon April 20, 2026 Where to Watch in BrooklineThe Beacon Street stretch of the course provides nearly three miles of vantage points and plenty of places to grab a snack before heading downtown for the finish on Boylston.Get the latest on the BAA App!Download the BAA App or head to the official BAA Site for race tracking, leaderboards, information, course maps and more on marathon day.Road & MBTA ClosuresRoadsParking on Beacon Street is prohibited starting on 4 pm Sunday, 4/19. Additionally, parking will be heavily restricted on roads adjacent to the marathon route.Expect the following roads to be closed approximately 8 am to 6 pm: Beacon StreetChestnut Hill Ave at Clinton Road and Dean RoadWashington Street at Park StreetHarvard Street at Longwood Ave and Sewall AveSaint Paul Street at Longwood AveSewall Ave at Marshall StreetMBTA (T train) closuresExpect the Kent and St. Mary stops (Green Line C Branch to Cleveland Circle) to be closed 10 am to 6 pm.Need to Cross the Marathon Route?No motor vehicles can cross the route from approximately 8 am to 6 pm, but pedestrians and bikes can only cross at the corners of:(Note: Pedestrian crossings may be limited at peak runner density, typically 1 - 3 pm)Beacon Street and Tappan StreetBeacon Street and Fairbanks StreetBeacon Street and Webster StreetBeacon Street and Hawes Street Accessible Schedule - ALL MARATHON DAY TIMES ARE APPROXIMATEBeacon Street Parking Ban Begins - 4:00 pm Sunday, 4/19Beacon Street & Other Roads Closed - 8:00 am Monday, 4/20BOSTON MARATHON BEGINS - 9:00 amWilliam Dawes Ride arrives at Florida Ruffin Ridley School - ~9:30 - 10:00 amTimeline for Participants Passing Coolidge CornerWheelchair Men - 10:15 amWheelchair Women - 10:28 amPro Men - 11:30 amPro Women - 11:57 amDesignated Pedestrian Crossings May Be Limited - 1:00 pm - 3:00 pmBeacon Street & Other Roads Reopen - 6:00 pm - Reopening times may vary Stay Connected!
